entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: A college of magic on the island of Lat-Nam, the largest congregation of magic and artifice in Dominaria during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: An island on Dominaria where the school was based.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the school stands.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The ancestor of the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Leader of the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: An archmage who schemed with Lim-Dûl against Jodah and later led and then fled the school.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who made a trade with Gerda for Jodah, defeated in Lim-Dûl's Battle.

entities.name: Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn
entities.description: A pit of black mana magically transported beneath the school.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker who left with Jodah and later stopped the school's destruction.

entities.name: Ozmar Starkaadison
entities.description: Left Lat-Nam with Gerda carrying the school's inventory.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Caster of the world-shattering World Spell.

entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: The melting of glaciers after the World Spell, flooding Terisiare.

entities.name: Fall of the School of the Unseen
entities.description: The swift destruction of the school by Steam Beasts and War Beasts teleported into the pit.

entities.name: Royal Academy of Magic
entities.description: A rival school in Krov, the counterpoint to the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Later built a new campus on Lat-Nam.

events.summary: The school is forced to relocate at the start of the Ice Age and settles on newly risen land.
events.quote: the scholars settled on new land risen from the sea, south and west from the original island of Lat-Nam.

events.summary: Gerda trades Jodah to Lim-Dûl for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn, giving her access to a pool of black mana.
events.quote: In a bid for power, she exchanged Jodah in return for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn .

events.summary: Lim-Dûl is defeated; Jodah survives and returns to rule, with Gerda as his second-in-command as punishment.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl was defeated in Lim-Dûl's Battle , but Jodah survived his ordeal and returned to rule the school

events.summary: The Thaw and the Flooding of Terisiare lift the veil hiding the school, and its scholars help evacuate and resettle flood victims.
events.quote: During these critical early years they helped evacuate, rescue, and resettle those whose homes and towns were lost to the floods.

events.summary: Jodah leaves with Jaya Ballard to hunt Mairsil-Lim-Dûl's spirit, leaving Gerda in charge.
events.quote: Jodah left with Jaya Ballard to track down the remainder of Mairsil -Lim-Dûl's spirit and left Gerda in charge of the school.

events.summary: Steam Beasts and War Beasts are teleported into the pit beneath the school, destroying it; Gerda kills one War Beast but cannot save it.
participants: Fall of the School of the Unseen
events.quote: The destruction of the school was swift and total

events.summary: Newly ascended planeswalker Jaya Ballard stops the destruction.
events.quote: was only stopped in the end by the newly ascended planeswalker Jaya Ballard

events.summary: Gerda and Ozmar leave Lat-Nam for good; Jodah grants Gerda the position of Archmage of the Unseen.
events.quote: she was legally granted the position of Archmage of the Unseen by Jodah

relations.quote: It lasted millennia and was led by Jodah , Archmage Eternal.
was scheming with the necromancer Lim-Dûl to displace Jodah as leader
The School of the Unseen was a college of magic based on the island of Lat-Nam on Dominaria .
There was a counterpoint to the academy, a rival school on the opposite of the continent
